content.thinking: np.cumsum doesn't accept `casting`. Let me just assign: cv[:,1:] = np.cumsum(vx, axis=1) — with int64 output into int64 ✓. Same for blpre.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/submission && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='topo.py'; s=open(p).read()
s = s.replace("            np.cumsum(blext, axis=1, out=pre[:, 1:], casting='unsafe')",
              "            pre[:, 1:] = np.cumsum(blext, axis=1)")
s = s.replace("        np.cumsum(vx, axis=1, out=cv[:, 1:], casting='unsafe')",
              "        cv[:, 1:] = np.cumsum(vx, axis=1)")
s = s.replace("        np.cumsum(cnt, out=indptr[1:], casting='unsafe')",
              "        indptr[1:] = np.cumsum(cnt)")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
